title: Create a smart list
blurb: Save a filtered group, like "Hot leads" or "Customers in Tauranga".

steps.title: Add your first rule
steps.body: Pick a field, a condition and a value. For example: Tags, includes, hot-lead.

steps.title: Add more rules
steps.body: Use **Add Nested Filter** when people must match both rules, or **Add Filter** when either rule is fine. Then click **Apply**.

steps.title: Save it as a list
steps.body: Save the filtered view as a new smart list and give it a clear name. It appears as a tab along the top.

steps.title: It keeps itself up to date
steps.body: You can't add people to a smart list by hand. Anyone who matches the rules shows up automatically, and drops off when they stop matching.
steps.tip: Share a list with your team from the three-dot menu next to **Add Contact**.
